description: The Mellum line on raw-recurrence-v6, from BF16 Mellum or, when they pass its init gate, conversion v3's latents (heads from maple/foundation_heads.py --precision bf16 --init-receipt; foundation stages = token-preserving-foundation-mellum-v2): the latent backbone policy (BF16 latents; the shared quantization component makes them int4/ternary over the curriculum). Backbone-inherent overrides only: cutoff 27, 512 contexts, the latent policy (the Maple-family port's auto policy is the ternary qat), no nested-family member terms (a BF16 student has no member state yet), and the Mellum-tokenized parts of conversion v3 reused: the init (v3 latents, gated), the behaviour-preservation stream (KL to BF16 on mellum21-self-distill-v3-20261010 via the teacher-v3 top-64 shards) and the per-precision behaviour gate (v3's generation gate and held KL). History: recipes/HISTORY.md.

init.description: Start from conversion v3's best latents when, at lambda=0, they still pass the BF16 behaviour gate (python -m natlang_neuralese.train.quantization init-gate); otherwise BF16 Mellum. The ternary point keeps at least v3's lambda at that step. Fresh optimizer: v3's LionSR state belongs to another objective (no implicit optimizer handoff).

reference.source: BF16 Mellum, conversion v3 gate.jsonl step 0 (18/24 probes)
